uploads.notAllowed: This page is not allowed to send files.
uploads.purpose: That is not a kind of picture the panel uploads.
uploads.tooLarge: This file is too large to upload here.
uploads.overLimit: This file is larger than the {size} MB the site allows.
uploads.failed: The file could not be uploaded.

pictureField.failed: The file could not be uploaded.
pictureField.willRemove: The picture will be removed when you save.
pictureField.done: {file} is uploaded. Save to use it.

errors.type: That is not a kind of node.
errors.id: That is not a record of this site.
errors.order: Every display order must be a whole number.
errors.file: That is not an uploaded file.
errors.nothingChosen: Choose a picture to upload or remove one before saving.

notices.moderated: The member now moderates this forum.
notices.unmoderated: The member no longer moderates this forum.
notices.deactivated: Threads still carry this prefix, so it is deactivated instead: they keep it and no thread can newly take it.

tree.subtitle: The categories and forums of the site, in the order the forum list shows them.
tree.counts: {threads, plural, one {# thread} other {# threads}} · {posts, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}
tree.empty: There is no category or forum yet.
tree.emptyDescription: Add the first one with the buttons above.

sort.subtitle: Move categories and forums up or down among those under the same parent. Each group is saved on its own.
sort.emptyDescription: Order only changes among nodes that share a parent, and none does yet.

create.title: Title
create.parentHelp: Where it sits in the tree.
create.positionHelp: Lower numbers come first. Leave empty for the default.
create.iconHelp: Drawn before the title on the forum list.
create.tabHelp: Only for a category with no parent.
create.subtitleCategory: A category groups forums and holds no threads.

tabs.heading: Forum list tabs
tabs.description: The tabs of the forum list. A top level category is given a tab in its own editor.
tabs.deleteWarning: Delete the tab {title}? Its categories stay, and belong to no tab.
tabs.none: There is no tab: the forum list shows no tabs.

tabForm.subtitle: A tab of the forum list. A top level category is given a tab in its own editor.
tabForm.title: Title
tabForm.positionHelp: Lower numbers come first. Leave empty for the default.

edit.subtitle: {type}: its settings, pictures and moderators.
edit.title: Title
edit.parentHelp: Moving a node moves everything under it. A node cannot go under itself.
edit.positionHelp: Lower numbers come first among nodes with the same parent.
edit.iconHelp: Drawn before the title on the forum list.
edit.tabHelp: The tab of the forum list this top level category sits in.
edit.readOnlyHelp: Nobody can start threads or reply here.
edit.minAccountAgeDaysHelp: Days an account must have existed before posting here.
edit.minPostCountHelp: Posts a member must have written before posting here.
edit.threadApprovalHelp: New threads wait for a moderator to approve them.
edit.replyApprovalHelp: New replies wait for a moderator to approve them.

pictures.heading: Pictures
pictures.description: The icon and the cover of this node, shown on the public forum list.
pictures.iconHelp: Replaces the icon of the forum list. Saved when you save this block.
pictures.coverHelp: A wide picture shown behind the node. Saved when you save this block.

moderators.heading: Moderators
moderators.description: Members who moderate this forum and everything under it.
moderators.removeWarning: {name} will no longer moderate this forum. Their other permissions stay as they are.
moderators.truncated: More members hold a moderation permission than the roster lists.

prefixes.subtitle: The labels a thread can carry in front of its title. A prefix is offered in every forum.
prefixes.deleteWarning: Deleting a prefix that threads still carry deactivates it instead: they keep it and no thread can newly take it.
prefixes.noneDescription: Add the first one with the button above.

prefixForm.label: Label
prefixForm.colourHelp: From the prefix palette, under Appearance.
prefixForm.iconHelp: The key of an icon the site knows (for example tag, sparkles or scale). Leave empty for none.
prefixForm.activeHelp: Members can put this prefix on new threads.
prefixForm.subtitle: A short label with a colour from the prefix palette.
